# Regenerating the documentation {#admin-guide-regeneration}

This documentation is generated content, held to the same discipline as every
other manifest-derived surface:

- Each reference page states the **exact tool version it was written
  against** — a version-lock note naming the pin — so every page is
  bound to a tool version.
- When a package bump or a release moves a tool's version, that
  tool's page is **regenerated in the same change**; the repository's
  coverage and provenance checks enforce this (a page whose recorded
  pin no longer matches the lock blocks merge). Upstream interface
  drift is answered by regeneration — never by hand-editing a
  generated page.
- **Coverage invariant**: every enabled tool has a complete page or an
  explicit pending stub with a stated reason — the check that proves
  it is the same CI gate, and tools never vanish silently from the
  reference.

The generation pipeline and enforcement gate are the tool-section
lanes of this window ([the coverage page](../reference/coverage.qmd)
tracks their status); per-release and per-bump regen obligations are
ledgered on the standing upkeep issue.
